scope.summary: Extend Atelier-owned sheet artifact links for typed Tailor assets through the merged Atelier API while keeping Atelier as the sole link authority.
acceptance_criteria: Atelier owns hsk.atelier.sheet_artifact_link@2 and the authoritative link store/API; Tailor invokes that API and stores only its typed reference, never a parallel sheet-link row or direct store mutation.

Each link carries a first-class schema_id and semantic content_hash, or an exactly verified immutable manifest rule that resolves both; character stable ref and immutable sheet-version ref are stored separately.
BodySpec, BodyRecipe, BodyPose, Garment, Fit, Drape, Capture, and interlink receipt links validate source/target schema versions, expected base, actor, lease, event, and idempotent replay.
Execution requires the MT-710 merge/containment receipt and explicit cross-WP CKC ownership approval for the Atelier API/migration change.

Merged migration 0340_atelier_sheet_artifact_links.sql is read-only historical evidence; @2 changes use a new forward migration whose final sequence number is collision-checked against merged main at activation and never rewrite applied migration history.
scope.risk_if_missed: A Tailor-owned duplicate link table would split character-sheet authority and make unlink/replay/promotion behavior irreconcilable.

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Non-UI scope: behavior is observable through typed Tailor state, receipts, captures, diagnostics, and TraceProjection; the owning native-shell MT verifies GUI projection.

target_entries: Tailor model manual > Atelier-owned sheet links

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: The implementing MT emits or projects its applicable Tailor lifecycle, command, job, validation, or authority event through the shared Flight Recorder contract; pure solver kernels surface typed receipts through their owning run.
The shared internal_diagnostics substrate is supplied by WP-KERNEL-012/WP-KERNEL-016; use its open projection contract and do not fork a Tailor-only diagnostics runtime.
The shared Palmistry watcher is supplied by WP-KERNEL-012/WP-KERNEL-016; long-running Tailor jobs inherit bounded child-stall and survivor coverage during the retrofit.

risks: Broad MT scope can hide multiple review targets.
Markdown MT lists may disagree with packet-declared active/next MT truth.
Receipt routing may target an old MT if contract identity is omitted.
minimum_controls: Exactly one primary proof target per MT unless the packet records why not.
MT identity must be stable and referenced by receipt correlation.
Generated projection drift must not wake Coder or Validator by itself.
